reviewRecord.body:
Evidence-Deviation-Case: endurance-managed-memory-observations
Evidence-Deviation-SHA256: cd311ad7f094977e6258851c4d1359265485f4a56ef0bbf257e392cf81dc57e3
Disposition: ACCEPT_SCOPED_DEVIATION

Reviewed commit:
73d6855090fac1f0733cccb3581200549fb739c8

My review covers the code and recorded case reports. I personally replayed the original raw artifacts using the verification tools.

According to the retained reports, the 72-hour workload, transaction accounting, recovery from nine incidents and Kafka restoration completed. Seven managed-memory readings remain invalid, and their historical cause remains unproven. The subsequent one-hour diagnostic does not establish that cause. 

I accept a narrowly scoped exception for these seven readings, this run and this source, on these conditions: the original rejected verdict is preserved, missing values are never reconstructed, and additional defects or recurrence reopen the case.

This review authorizes administrative closure only as
CLOSED_WITH_ACCEPTED_DEVIATION for the specified run, source
and seven readings.

ownerAuthorization.statement: With my authorization and explicit recording of these items, close phase 62 provisionally so we can continue.
ownerAuthorization.originalStatement:
با مجوز من و ثبت صریح این موارد، فعلا 62 رو ببند
تا ادامه بدیم

carryForward: Detailed replay commands, tool versions and output receipts are not attached to the acceptance review; the owner authorizes administrative closure with this limitation recorded.
The historical sampling root cause is unproven and the seven missing readings remain unreconstructed.
The accepted review is bound to its exact historical head and bundle; later source/package/scope changes require separate assessment.
Any additional defect, recurrence, scope/evidence/SDK change or independent rejection reopens the risk decision.
Phases 63-65, final-package qualification and stable/operator release gates remain open and mandatory.
